Explore any MetaLab dataset interactively: effect sizes across age, and a
funnel plot for publication-bias diagnostics. Pick a dataset and an
effect-size measure; data loads in your browser.

{{< include components/_spinner.qmd >}}
{{< include components/_loess.qmd >}}
{{< include components/_style.qmd >}}
{{< include components/_download.qmd >}}

```{ojs setup}
//| output: false
// Plot, d3, Inputs, htl all come bundled with Quarto's OJS runtime -- no
// external CDN imports (they hang in CSP-restricted environments)
registry = d3.json("slices/datasets.json")

es_choices = new Map([
  ["Hedges' g", "g"], ["Cohen's d", "d"], ["Pearson's r", "r"], ["Log odds", "log_odds"]
])

es_labels = ({ g: "Hedges' g", d: "Cohen's d", r: "Pearson's r", log_odds: "Log odds" })

solar_blue = "#268bd2"

domain_titles = new Map([
  ["early_language", "Early language"],
  ["cognitive_development", "Cognitive development"]
])

url_dataset = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("dataset")
```

:::: {.viz-layout}

::: {.viz-sidebar}

```{ojs inputs-dataset}
viewof domain = Inputs.select([...domain_titles.keys()], {
  label: "Domain",
  format: (d) => domain_titles.get(d),
  value: url_dataset
    ? registry.find((d) => d.short_name === url_dataset)?.domain
    : "early_language"
})

viewof dataset_name = Inputs.select(
  registry.filter((d) => d.domain === domain).map((d) => d.name),
  { label: "Dataset",
    value: url_dataset
      ? registry.find((d) => d.short_name === url_dataset)?.name
      : undefined }
)
```

```{ojs inputs-es}
dataset_meta = registry.find((d) => d.name === dataset_name)

viewof es_type = Inputs.select(es_choices, { label: "Effect size type", value: "g" })

viewof subset_choice = {
  const subsets = dataset_meta.subset ?? [];
  return Inputs.radio(["All data", ...subsets], {
    label: subsets.length ? "Subset" : "",
    value: "All data"
  });
}

viewof curve_type = Inputs.radio(new Map([["LOESS", "loess"], ["Linear", "lm"]]), {
  label: "Smoothing curve",
  value: "loess"
})
```

```{ojs dataset-blurb}
html`<div style="font-size: 0.82rem; color: #555; margin-top: 0.75rem;">
  <p>${dataset_meta.short_desc ?? ""}</p>
  <p><em>Citation:</em> ${dataset_meta.full_citation ?? dataset_meta.citation ?? ""}</p>
  ${dataset_meta.sheet_status === "unavailable_upstream"
    ? html`<p class="card-frozen">This dataset is frozen at its ${dataset_meta.data_as_of} state (source sheet unavailable).</p>` : ""}
  <p><a href="resources/csv/${dataset_meta.filename}.csv" download>Download full dataset (CSV)</a></p>
</div>`
```

:::

::: {.viz-main}

```{ojs load-slice}
//| output: false
slice_all = d3.json(`slices/es/${dataset_meta.short_name}.json`)

slice = subset_choice === "All data"
  ? slice_all
  : slice_all.filter((d) => d[subset_choice] === true)

es_col = `${es_type}_calc`
es_var_col = `${es_type}_var_calc`

// rows with a defined ES of the selected type and (for the scatter) age;
// mean_age < 4000 days ~ 131.4 months, matching the legacy app's filter
plot_data = slice.filter((d) =>
  Number.isFinite(+d[es_col]) && Number.isFinite(+d[es_var_col]))
age_data = plot_data.filter((d) =>
  Number.isFinite(+d.mean_age_months) && +d.mean_age_months < 4000 / 30.44)
```

```{ojs value-boxes}
model_note = {
  clear_loading();
  const wmean = d3.sum(plot_data, (d) => +d[es_col] / +d[es_var_col]) /
    d3.sum(plot_data, (d) => 1 / +d[es_var_col]);
  return html`<div style="display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.75rem;">
    <div class="value-box"><div class="vb-value">${plot_data.length}</div>
      <div class="vb-label">Conditions</div></div>
    <div class="value-box"><div class="vb-value">${wmean.toFixed(2)}</div>
      <div class="vb-label">Weighted mean ${es_labels[es_type]}<br>(multilevel model: coming soon)</div></div>
  </div>`;
}
```

#### Effect sizes across age

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Plot

```{ojs scatter}
scatter_plot = {
  if (dataset_meta.longitudinal)
    return html`<p style="color:#777;"><em>This is a longitudinal dataset;
      effect sizes do not correspond to single test ages, so the age scatter
      is not shown.</em></p>`;
  const inv_var = (d) => 1 / Math.max(+d[es_var_col], 1e-9);
  const curve = curve_type === "loess"
    ? loess_points(age_data, { x: "mean_age_months", y: es_col, w: inv_var, span: 1 })
    : wls_points(age_data, { x: "mean_age_months", y: es_col, w: inv_var });
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 750, height: 420,
    marginLeft: 55,
    x: { label: "Mean subject age (months)" },
    y: { label: `Effect size (${es_labels[es_type]})` },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0], { strokeDasharray: "4,3", stroke: "#999" }),
      Plot.dot(age_data, {
        x: "mean_age_months", y: es_col, r: (d) => Math.sqrt(+d.n || 1),
        fill: solar_blue, fillOpacity: 0.5,
        title: (d) => `${d.short_cite}\nexpt ${d.expt_num ?? ""} · n=${d.n}\n${es_labels[es_type]} = ${(+d[es_col]).toFixed(2)}`,
        tip: true
      }),
      Plot.line(curve, { x: "mean_age_months", y: es_col, stroke: solar_blue, strokeWidth: 2 })
    ]
  });
}
```

## Table

```{ojs scatter-table}
Inputs.table(plot_data.map((d) => ({
  study: d.short_cite, expt: d.expt_num, n: d.n,
  age_months: +(+d.mean_age_months).toFixed(1),
  es: +(+d[es_col]).toFixed(3), es_var: +(+d[es_var_col]).toFixed(4),
  method: d.method, exposure: d.exposure_phase
})), { rows: 18 })
```

```{ojs scatter-download}
download_csv(plot_data, `${dataset_meta.short_name}_${es_type}.csv`)
```

#### Funnel plot of bias in effect sizes

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Plot

```{ojs funnel}
funnel_plot = {
  const pts = plot_data.map((d) => ({
    es: +d[es_col], se: Math.sqrt(+d[es_var_col]),
    cite: d.short_cite, expt: d.expt_num
  }));
  const center = d3.mean(pts, (d) => d.es);
  const L = 1.05 * d3.max(pts, (d) => d.se);
  // funnel triangles: at depth se, the z% region spans center ± z*se
  const grid = d3.range(0, L * 1.0001, L / 60);
  const tri95 = grid.map((s) => ({ se: s, x1: center - 1.96 * s, x2: center + 1.96 * s }));
  const tri99 = grid.map((s) => ({ se: s, x1: center - 2.58 * s, x2: center + 2.58 * s }));
  const xmin = Math.min(center - 2.58 * L, d3.min(pts, (d) => d.es));
  const xmax = Math.max(center + 2.58 * L, d3.max(pts, (d) => d.es));
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 750, height: 420,
    marginLeft: 55,
    x: { label: `Effect size (${es_labels[es_type]})`, domain: [xmin, xmax] },
    y: { label: "Standard error", domain: [0, L], reverse: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.rect([{}], { x1: xmin, x2: xmax, y1: 0, y2: L, fill: "#e6e6e6" }),
      Plot.areaX(tri99, { y: "se", x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: "#fff", fillOpacity: 0.5 }),
      Plot.areaX(tri95, { y: "se", x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: "#fff", fillOpacity: 0.5 }),
      Plot.ruleX([center], { strokeDasharray: "2,2", stroke: "#333" }),
      Plot.dot(pts, {
        x: "es", y: "se", fill: solar_blue, fillOpacity: 0.7,
        title: (d) => `${d.cite}\nexpt ${d.expt ?? ""}\nes = ${d.es.toFixed(2)}, se = ${d.se.toFixed(2)}`,
        tip: true
      })
    ]
  });
}
```

## Table

```{ojs funnel-table}
Inputs.table(plot_data.map((d) => ({
  study: d.short_cite, expt: d.expt_num,
  es: +(+d[es_col]).toFixed(3), se: +Math.sqrt(+d[es_var_col]).toFixed(3)
})), { rows: 18 })
```
